description: Token replay via timingSafeEqual: send a stolen token cookie from a different IP/network within the validity window
expectedBehavior: Server validates token is valid; no IP-binding or session pinning is enforced, so replayed token is accepted
failureMode: Stolen dashboard tokens can be replayed from any origin until expiry, enabling persistent unauthorized access
prerequisites: Attacker has captured a valid dashboard token (e.g. via XSS or network sniffing on same LAN)

description: Token generated via randomBytes(32) without rotation policy; determine if long-lived sessions are possible
expectedBehavior: Token is created once per session; no expiry or rotation mechanism is present
failureMode: Sessions are effectively permanent — once authenticated, a token never expires unless the server restarts
prerequisites: Victim authenticates to dashboard

description: WebSocket broadcast contains full state including wallet private keys or seed phrases if present in state
expectedBehavior: State is serialized and broadcast to all connected WebSocket clients every 2 seconds
failureMode: If state contains sensitive key material, any WebSocket client (including unauthenticated connections) receives it
prerequisites: State object includes wallet key material; WebSocket upgrade does not require auth token

description: WebSocket connections are accepted without authentication; determine if WS upgrade path checks token
expectedBehavior: WebSocket server accepts all upgrade requests without token challenge
failureMode: Unauthenticated clients can subscribe to full bot state stream including positions, balances, and config
prerequisites: Bot is running and dashboard server is listening

description: Port conflict resolution uses fuser/lsof which can be tricked if attacker binds to the dashboard port first
expectedBehavior: Server kills the process holding the port and binds; attacker-controlled process could be restarted continuously
failureMode: A local attacker can cause repeated port conflicts, preventing dashboard from stabilizing
prerequisites: Local user access on the same machine

description: IPC command injection via writeAutomationCommand: attacker writes a crafted command to the JSON file that overrides lifecycle
expectedBehavior: Commands are validated against ALLOWED_LIFECYCLE_CMDS before writing
failureMode: If allowlist is missing entries or uses partial matching, arbitrary commands could be injected
prerequisites: Attacker gains filesystem write access to the IPC directory

description: Slash commands validated against ALLOWED_SLASH_CMDS; determine if allowlist is comprehensive or can be bypassed
expectedBehavior: Only predefined slash commands are accepted
failureMode: Missing or incomplete allowlist entries could allow dangerous operations via slash commands
prerequisites: Attacker has dashboard access or can forge IPC file writes

description: Telegram HTML messaging without explicit allowlist of HTML tags; xss in rendered messages
expectedBehavior: htmlEscape is called on user-controlled content before sending
failureMode: If htmlEscape is bypassed or incomplete, malicious HTML/JS could be rendered in Telegram clients
prerequisites: Attacker controls a token name, symbol, or other field that gets included in Telegram output

description: Telegram long-polling for incoming commands without HMAC or sender verification
expectedBehavior: All messages from configured chat are processed as commands
failureMode: Anyone who gains access to the Telegram chat can send commands; no cryptographic sender verification
prerequisites: Attacker is a member of the Telegram group or compromises a group member's account

description: Pilot mode capping in computeDeployAmount: verify pilot caps cannot be bypassed by negative or NaN values
expectedBehavior: Deploy amount is capped by pilot limits
failureMode: If input validation is missing for edge values (NaN, Infinity, negative), pilot caps could be bypassed
prerequisites: User-config provides a deploy amount that passes through computeDeployAmount

description: Tool timeout at 90s may allow long-running operations to complete after caller has abandoned them
expectedBehavior: Promise.race rejects after 90s timeout; underlying operation is NOT aborted
failureMode: Dangling operations (e.g. swap transactions) may complete asynchronously after timeout, causing unexpected state transitions
prerequisites: Network latency or RPC congestion causes operation to exceed 90s

description: Confirm-mode intercept for BUYs: determine if confirm dialog can be bypassed by race condition or rapid orders
expectedBehavior: BUY transactions pause for human confirmation
failureMode: Race condition between multiple rapid BUY orders could bypass confirm-mode gate
prerequisites: Multiple high-priority BUY triggers arrive simultaneously

description: Safety checks run after balance verification but before swap; verify atomicity of check-then-act
expectedBehavior: Balance check occurs and swap proceeds if sufficient
failureMode: TOCTOU race: balance changes between check and swap execution, causing overspend or failed tx
prerequisites: Concurrent operations modify wallet balance (e.g. vault sweep runs simultaneously)

description: ProBuyDecision with 8 signals: determine if any single signal can dominate and bypass risk checks
expectedBehavior: All 8 signals are weighed; no single signal overrides others
failureMode: A heavily weighted signal (e.g. regime confidence at 100%) could mask negative signals from other subsystems
prerequisites: Market regime strongly favors one dimension while other risk metrics are negative

description: PRO_THRESHOLDS for buy/sell/cutloss are hardcoded; determine if thresholds can be manipulated via config injection
expectedBehavior: Thresholds are loaded from configuration and validated
failureMode: If config injection is possible, thresholds could be set to 0 or negative values bypassing all gates
prerequisites: Attacker has write access to user-config.json or environment variables that override thresholds

description: 7-component strategy readiness validation: determine if component scores can be inflated by crafted input
expectedBehavior: Each component has independent scoring logic with bounded output
failureMode: If any component accepts unvalidated external input, scores could be artificially inflated
prerequisites: External data source (e.g. market data API) feeds into component scoring

description: KNOWN_SCAM_PATTERNS with multi-language (CN,RU,KR,ES): test for false positive via legitimate foreign terms matching scam patterns
expectedBehavior: Pattern matching flags tokens with scam indicators
failureMode: Legitimate foreign-language token names could match scam patterns, causing false-positive blocks
prerequisites: Token name contains characters or phrases that overlap with scam keyword lists

description: LEGITIMATE_PROJECTS hardcoded list for copycat detection: verify list is version-controlled and auditable
expectedBehavior: Tokens matching known legitimate projects bypass certain trash checks
failureMode: Stale or incomplete LEGITIMATE_PROJECTS list could allow copycats to bypass detection
prerequisites: Copycat token uses name similar to a project not yet in the legitimate list

description: RugCheck.xyz integration response parsing: test for SSRF or data injection via malicious API response
expectedBehavior: API response is parsed as structured data with validation
failureMode: If response is parsed without schema validation, malicious API responses could inject fake risk scores
prerequisites: RugCheck.xyz API is compromised or returns crafted response

description: WebSocket with exponential backoff 1-30s: test for reconnection storm if server rapidly connects/disconnects
expectedBehavior: Backoff reduces reconnection frequency
failureMode: If server-side closes connections rapidly (e.g. rate limiting), the backoff-reset logic could cause a reconnection storm
prerequisites: Helius endpoint returns 429 or WebSocket rate limit errors

description: API key redaction in logs: verify key pattern is consistently redacted across all log paths
expectedBehavior: API keys are redacted in log output
failureMode: If a new log path or error handler misses redaction, API keys leak to log files
prerequisites: Error occurs in a code path not covered by the redaction regex

description: DRY_RUN mode for vault sweep: verify dry-run cannot accidentally execute real transfers
expectedBehavior: DRY_RUN skips actual transfer execution
failureMode: If DRY_RUN flag is incorrectly evaluated (e.g. type coercion), real transfers could execute during dry-run mode
prerequisites: vault sweep is triggered with DRY_RUN=true

description: Profit-sweep transfer to external wallet: verify destination address validation
expectedBehavior: Destination address is validated before transfer
failureMode: If destination validation is missing, funds could be sent to an invalid or attacker-controlled address
prerequisites: Vault destination address is misconfigured or compromised

description: File-locked state publishing: test for TOCTOU in file lock acquisition
expectedBehavior: Lock prevents concurrent writes to state file
failureMode: TOCTOU between lock check and lock acquisition could allow concurrent writes, corrupting state
prerequisites: Multiple processes or threads attempt to write state simultaneously

description: Supervisor/automation command IPC: verify IPC channel is local-only and not exposed to network
expectedBehavior: IPC commands are written to local filesystem, not network sockets
failureMode: If IPC directory is shared (NFS, Docker volume mount), remote processes could inject commands
prerequisites: Bot runs in environment with shared filesystem access

description: ScoreDevReputation uses external data that could be manipulated via Sybil attacks
expectedBehavior: Reputation score is computed from multiple data sources
failureMode: If a single data source dominates, attacker could Sybil-farm reputation for malicious deployers
prerequisites: Attacker controls multiple test wallets or social accounts

description: MarkDevCoinOutcome writes to persistent file; test for injection via malicious dev address
expectedBehavior: Dev address is validated before writing to outcome tracking
failureMode: If dev address is not sanitized, path traversal or injection into outcome file is possible
prerequisites: Attacker controls a token deployer address with crafted characters

description: 17 narrative categories with keyword matching: test for regex injection via crafted token metadata
expectedBehavior: Keywords are matched safely against predefined patterns
failureMode: If keyword patterns are constructed dynamically from user input, regex injection is possible
prerequisites: Attacker controls token name or metadata that feeds into keyword pattern construction

description: Cross-batch velocity tracking writes to persistent file; test for file corruption under concurrent access
expectedBehavior: Velocity data is updated atomically
failureMode: Concurrent narrative updates from multiple triggers could corrupt velocity tracking data
prerequisites: Multiple token screenings occur simultaneously

description: 5 detection subsystems (GROUP,SOLO,CONFLICT,DISTRIBUTION,FOMO): test for algorithmic bias in scoring
expectedBehavior: Each subsystem produces independent scores
failureMode: If any subsystem has algorithmic bias (e.g. flags all high-volume tokens as GROUP manipulation), cascade into false positives
prerequisites: Token exhibits legitimate high trading volume from organic users

description: 2s broadcast loop sends full state; determine if state object contains user-config.json secrets
expectedBehavior: State is broadcast with all properties
failureMode: Sensitive config values (API keys, wallet seed, RPC endpoints) may be exposed in state broadcast
prerequisites: Dashboard is accessible on network; WebSocket client connects

description: REST endpoints for status/config/command/toggle: determine if auth middleware is applied to all routes
expectedBehavior: All routes require valid token via cookie or header
failureMode: If any route is missing auth middleware, unauthenticated access to sensitive operations is possible
prerequisites: A new route is added without auth middleware; or existing route has conditional auth

description: CRUD endpoints for trash-wallets, smart/dev/token-blacklist: test for mass assignment or unauthorized modification
expectedBehavior: CRUD operations check authorization before modifying data
failureMode: If authorization is checked only at route level (not operation level), a user could modify lists they shouldn't
prerequisites: Multiple user roles or access levels exist for list management

description: ANSI/CTRL character stripping in sanitizeLogText: test for bypass via Unicode control characters
expectedBehavior: Control characters are stripped from log text
failureMode: If regex only covers ASCII control characters, Unicode control characters (e.g. Unicode reverse) could bypass sanitization
prerequisites: Attacker injects Unicode control characters in token metadata that gets logged

description: Telegram error notification sends logs to external service; test for log content leakage
expectedBehavior: Error logs are sent to Telegram for operator awareness
failureMode: If error messages include sensitive data (keys, balances, addresses), Telegram becomes a data leak channel
prerequisites: Error occurs in a context with sensitive data in scope

description: toolMap routing determines which execution path is used; test for path traversal in tool name resolution
expectedBehavior: Tool names are matched against a predefined map
failureMode: If tool name is partially user-controlled, an attacker could route execution to an unexpected handler
prerequisites: Tool name is derived from external input (e.g. strategy output)

description: ProSellDecision with 5 signals: test for sell-decision lockup if all signals return undefined/NaN
expectedBehavior: Sell decision is reached via signal aggregation
failureMode: If all signals return undefined or NaN, aggregation could produce unexpected sell behavior (never sell or always sell)
prerequisites: Market data feeds are temporarily unavailable or return malformed data

description: ProCutlossDecision: test for infinite loop or recursive evaluation if price keeps dropping
expectedBehavior: Cutloss decision is reached and position is closed
failureMode: If cutloss logic re-evaluates without state checkpoint, a rapidly dropping price could cause infinite re-evaluation
prerequisites: Token price drops rapidly, triggering repeated cutloss evaluation

description: Helius API key in WebSocket URL construction: verify key is not exposed in URL logs or error messages
expectedBehavior: API key is sent as query parameter but redacted in logs
failureMode: If connection error includes full URL in stack trace or error message, API key leaks
prerequisites: WebSocket connection fails with error that echoes the connection URL

description: reloadScreeningThresholds hot-reload: test for race condition where thresholds are partially updated during evaluation
expectedBehavior: Thresholds are updated atomically
failureMode: If config reload is not atomic, a screening evaluation could read a mix of old and new thresholds
prerequisites: Config reload occurs simultaneously with token screening evaluation

description: getExitSlippage with progressive slippage: test for slippage exceeding configured maximums
expectedBehavior: Slippage is bounded by configuration maximum
failureMode: If progressive slippage calculation exceeds configured max without clamping, trades may execute at extreme slippage
prerequisites: Volatile market conditions cause progressive slippage to increase

description: File locking for cooldown state: test for deadlock if multiple tokens are evaluated simultaneously
expectedBehavior: File lock is acquired, state read/modified/written, lock released
failureMode: If file lock is not released on error, all subsequent cooldown checks deadlock
prerequisites: Error occurs during cooldown file write, leaving lock acquired

description: scanRefundableTokenAccounts: test for excessive RPC calls causing rate limit or resource exhaustion
expectedBehavior: Scans token accounts and computes refundable rent
failureMode: If scanning does not batch or limit RPC calls, Helius rate limits could block other bot operations
prerequisites: Wallet holds many token accounts (100+)

description: recordLossAnalysis writes to persistent file; test for malicious input in loss analysis data
expectedBehavior: Loss data is sanitized before storage
failureMode: If loss analysis includes unsanitized market data fields, injection into learning records is possible
prerequisites: Malicious token metadata is captured in loss analysis

description: recordObservations stores patterns from market data; test for adversarial pattern poisoning
expectedBehavior: Observations are recorded faithfully from market data
failureMode: Attacker can craft token behavior that produces misleading observation patterns, poisoning the learning model
prerequisites: Attacker controls tokens that the bot screens and observes

description: pruneConvictionMemory and related functions write to persistent files; test for deletion of wrong entries via path traversal
expectedBehavior: Pruning targets specific records by validation criteria
failureMode: If record identifiers are not validated, path traversal could delete unintended data files
prerequisites: Record identifier contains path traversal characters

description: attachExitMonitor checks priceDrop; test for false triggers from micro-dust or flash crashes
expectedBehavior: Exit monitor triggers only on sustained price drops
failureMode: If threshold is too sensitive, micro-dust or brief flash crashes could trigger false exits
prerequisites: Token experiences normal volatility near the exit threshold

description: Kelly/VaR/CVaR/drawdown calculations: test for division by zero or NaN propagation in risk calculations
expectedBehavior: Risk metrics are computed with guard rails for edge cases
failureMode: If input validation is missing, division by zero or NaN values could cascade into all dependent systems
prerequisites: Market data with zero volatility or undefined price movement

description: simulateTrade through strategy.js exit logic: test for infinite loop if exit condition never triggers
expectedBehavior: Simulation completes within bounded iterations
failureMode: If exit condition is never met, simulation could loop indefinitely consuming CPU
prerequisites: Price sequence never triggers exit criteria in backtest

description: Environment variable overrides loaded from user-config.json; test for prototype pollution via config JSON
expectedBehavior: Config values are assigned to env object safely
failureMode: If JSON.parse is used without prototype pollution protection, __proto__ payloads could pollute global state
prerequisites: Attacker can modify user-config.json content

description: Cookie+header auth: verify both must be present; test for bypass by providing only one
expectedBehavior: Both cookie and header must match for authentication
failureMode: If auth logic uses OR instead of AND, providing only one factor could bypass auth
prerequisites: Attacker has either cookie or header but not both

description: user-config.json loads sensitive values (RPC keys, wallet configs); test for file permissions exposure
expectedBehavior: Config file is loaded from predictable path
failureMode: If file permissions are too permissive (644+), other processes/users on the machine can read sensitive config
prerequisites: Shared hosting or multi-user environment

description: logAction logs all trade operations; test for sensitive data in trade action logs
expectedBehavior: Trade actions are logged with relevant details
failureMode: If full transaction data including keys or signatures is logged, persistent log files become a data leak vector
prerequisites: Trade action includes verbose debug data in log output

description: filterPreyAdvanced 5-step pipeline: test for short-circuit logic allowing bypass of later steps
expectedBehavior: All 5 pipeline stages execute sequentially
failureMode: If early stage returns 'pass' without executing later stages, tokens skip critical validation
prerequisites: Pipeline implements early-return optimization that skips remaining stages

description: DexScreener API response parsing; test for prototype pollution in deeply nested response objects
expectedBehavior: API response is parsed into structured data
failureMode: If JSON.parse is used without depth limiting, deeply nested or __proto__ payloads could pollute objects
prerequisites: DexScreener API returns crafted payload with prototype pollution attempt

description: Jupiter quote/swap API integration; test for insufficient response validation allowing malicious quote manipulation
expectedBehavior: Quote response is validated before swap execution
failureMode: If quote validation is minimal, a man-in-the-middle could modify quote parameters leading to unfavorable swap
prerequisites: Network path to Jupiter API is compromised

description: Wallet discovery scans on-chain; test for excessive RPC usage causing rate limit cascade
expectedBehavior: Wallet discovery respects rate limits
failureMode: If discovery scans too aggressively, Helius rate limits block critical path operations (swap, screening)
prerequisites: Large wallet discovery scan is triggered

description: Devnet faucet requests; test for abuse if production mode accidentally uses devnet endpoint
expectedBehavior: Devnet tools are isolated from production paths
failureMode: If mode detection fails, production bot could request from devnet faucet or vice versa
prerequisites: Runtime mode detection returns incorrect environment

description: Kill switch mechanism; test for false triggers or inability to disarm once triggered
expectedBehavior: Kill switch stops all trading and can be disarmed
failureMode: If kill switch disarming is not implemented, all trading stops permanently until manual intervention
prerequisites: Kill switch is triggered by a critical error or manual command

description: Readiness check probes all subsystems; test for information disclosure via readiness endpoint
expectedBehavior: Readiness endpoint returns pass/fail for each subsystem
failureMode: If readiness includes detailed error messages, it leaks system topology and failure modes to network scanners
prerequisites: Readiness endpoint is exposed on network without authentication

description: Dashboard sends lifecycle command via writeDashboardCmd; verify command-writer correctly parses and routes to automation-control
expectedBehavior: Command is written as JSON IPC file, read by command-writer, validated, and forwarded to supervisor
failureMode: IPC file format mismatch between writer and reader causes silent command drop
prerequisites: Dashboard sends any lifecycle command (start, stop, pause, resume)

description: Pro-orchestrator buy decision triggers executor.adaptiveSwap; verify the full decision-to-execution pipeline
expectedBehavior: Buy decision parameters (token, amount, slippage) are correctly passed to executor
failureMode: Parameter mapping mismatch (field names, types, units) causes incorrect swap parameters
prerequisites: Pro-orchestrator reaches buy decision with populated signal data

description: Executor calls Jupiter quote then swap; verify quote parameters match swap execution
expectedBehavior: Quote output (route, amountOut) is passed faithfully to swap function
failureMode: Quote-to-swap parameter drift causes slippage violations or failed transactions
prerequisites: Executor processes a buy or sell order through Jupiter

description: Geyser stream events trigger exit monitor; verify account update parsing correctly routes to monitoring
expectedBehavior: Price change events from Geyser are parsed and forwarded to exit monitor for evaluation
failureMode: Event format mismatch (Geyser v0.3 vs v0.4) causes silent exit monitor failure
prerequisites: Geyser is connected and streaming token account updates

description: Trash-layer passes token through community detector; verify screening results are correctly merged
expectedBehavior: Community detector scores are folded into final filter decision
failureMode: Score normalization mismatch (0-1 vs 0-100 scale) causes incorrect filtering decisions
prerequisites: Token passes basic trash checks and enters community assessment

description: Community detector feeds trade data into cabal play analysis; verify data pipeline integrity
expectedBehavior: Trade history is passed to cabal analyzer for manipulation detection
failureMode: Data format mismatch (aggregated vs raw trades) causes incorrect cabal score
prerequisites: Token has trade history available for analysis

description: Config hot-reload propagates to all dependent modules; verify modules pick up new values without restart
expectedBehavior: Modules re-read config values on next access after reload
failureMode: Stale config references persist in modules that cache config at startup, ignoring hot-reload
prerequisites: Config values are changed via hot-reload (reloadScreeningThresholds or env override)

description: Logger sends error notifications via Telegram; verify Telegram sendMessage handles all severities
expectedBehavior: Error logs above threshold are formatted and sent as Telegram messages
failureMode: Telegram message size limits truncate important error context; or rate limiting blocks notifications
prerequisites: Error occurs with verbose context exceeding Telegram message limits

description: Auth middleware integrates with Express routes; verify middleware executes on all protected routes
expectedBehavior: Auth middleware is registered globally or on each protected route
failureMode: Route added without auth middleware inclusion; administrative endpoints accessible without token
prerequisites: New dashboard route is added without explicit auth middleware

description: Express server mounts API routes; verify route registration order doesn't cause shadowing
expectedBehavior: All API routes are registered and accessible at correct paths
failureMode: Route ordering causes catch-all or wildcard routes to shadow specific endpoints
prerequisites: Multiple route patterns exist with potential overlap (e.g., /api/:id and /api/config)

description: Vault sweep triggers executor for transfer; verify vault sweep parameters correctly enter execution pipeline
expectedBehavior: Vault sweep requests a token transfer via executor with correct destination and amount
failureMode: Transfer amount precision (lamports vs SOL) mismatch causes incorrect sweep amounts
prerequisites: Vault sweep interval triggers and computeVaultAmount returns a value

description: Automation control publishes state; verify dashboard picks up state changes via broadcast loop
expectedBehavior: State published by automation control is reflected in next dashboard broadcast
failureMode: State file write timing causes dashboard broadcast to show stale state for multiple cycles
prerequisites: Automation state changes frequently

description: State reads/writes by multiple modules; verify concurrent read/write consistency
expectedBehavior: State is atomically updated; all readers see consistent snapshots
failureMode: Concurrent write operations cause torn reads where a module reads partially updated state
prerequisites: Multiple modules (strategy, metrics, position tracker) access state simultaneously

description: Learning mode feeds observations into continuous learning; verify data flow from loss analysis to pattern learning
expectedBehavior: Loss analyses are recorded as observations in the continuous learning pipeline
failureMode: Data format mismatch causes loss data to be dropped before pattern extraction
prerequisites: A losing trade triggers loss analysis, which should feed into continuous learning

description: Neural risk scores feed into pro-orchestrator decisions; verify risk metrics correctly influence buy/sell thresholds
expectedBehavior: Kelly, VaR, and CVaR from neural-risk are integrated into conviction and sizing calculations
failureMode: Risk metrics not normalized to same scale as other pro-orchestrator signals, causing disproportionate influence
prerequisites: Neural-risk is enabled and producing scores

description: Exit-slippage provides progressive slippage configuration to executor during sells
expectedBehavior: Executor reads progressive slippage from exit-slippage module and applies to sell transactions
failureMode: Slippage calculation timing (pre-quote vs post-quote) causes quote/slippage mismatch
prerequisites: Sell order is triggered while token price is volatile

description: Pro-orchestrator checks trade cooldowns before buy decisions; verify cooldown state is consulted
expectedBehavior: Pro-orchestrator skips buy decisions for tokens on cooldown
failureMode: Cooldown check returns stale data because file lock delays cause the check to be skipped
prerequisites: Token was recently traded and should be on cooldown

description: Rent refund requests close accounts via executor; verify transaction is constructed correctly
expectedBehavior: Rent refund builds closeAccount instructions and sends via executor
failureMode: Close account instruction constructed with wrong account order or missing signer
prerequisites: Token accounts with refundable rent are identified

description: Data maintenance prunes state; verify pruning correctly removes old entries without corrupting active data
expectedBehavior: Pruning targets only entries meeting age/criteria thresholds
failureMode: Off-by-one or boundary error in pruning logic removes active or recent entries
prerequisites: Scheduled maintenance task triggers pruning of old records

description: Narrative detection scores influence pro-orchestrator conviction; verify narrative velocity metrics are correctly passed
expectedBehavior: Narrative classification and velocity data contribute to conviction scoring
failureMode: Narrative heat index uses different time windows than pro-orchestrator expects, causing conviction miscalculation
prerequisites: Token is classified under an active narrative category

description: Dashboard writes automation command, supervisor picks it up; verify command lifecycle (acknowledge, execute, respond)
expectedBehavior: Command file is written, supervisor detects, executes, and writes response
failureMode: Supervisor polling interval misses command; or response file naming convention mismatch
prerequisites: Operator issues a command via the dashboard

description: Community detector outcome data is cleaned by data maintenance; verify outcome records are correctly pruned
expectedBehavior: Old dev outcome records are pruned based on age criteria
failureMode: Pruning removes outcome data still referenced by active screening pipeline
prerequisites: Scheduled maintenance runs while active screenings reference outcome records

description: Telegram commands trigger executor actions; verify command parsing correctly maps to executor tool calls
expectedBehavior: Telegram command (e.g., /buy, /sell) is parsed and executor is called with correct parameters
failureMode: Parameter extraction fails for partial commands, causing executor to use defaults or fail
prerequisites: Operator sends a trading command via Telegram

description: Exit-slippage reads config for max slippage; verify hot-reloaded config values take effect immediately
expectedBehavior: Slippage configuration changes apply to next exit calculation
failureMode: Exit-slippage caches config at module load, ignoring hot-reload
prerequisites: Slippage configuration is updated while bot is running

description: Geyser subscription filters by account; verify exit monitor only receives relevant updates
expectedBehavior: Subscription filter limits updates to monitored positions
failureMode: Filter misconfiguration causes exit monitor to process all network updates, causing CPU exhaustion
prerequisites: Geyser subscribes to broad account update stream

description: Vault transfers update state; verify state reflects completed vault sweeps for dashboard display
expectedBehavior: After vault transfer, state is updated with new balances and transfer record
failureMode: State is updated before transfer confirms, showing incorrect post-transfer balance
prerequisites: Vault sweep executes a transfer

description: Continuous learning observations trigger data maintenance; verify maintenance respects learning data retention
expectedBehavior: Data maintenance prunes old observations but retains those marked as high-value
failureMode: Maintenance treats all observations equally, removing high-value learning data
prerequisites: Learning observation retention period is separate from general data retention

description: Backtest simulates trades through strategy exit logic; verify backtest faithfully reproduces live exit behavior
expectedBehavior: Backtest calls same exit logic as live trading path
failureMode: Backtest uses simplified exit logic that diverges from live path, giving false confidence
prerequisites: Strategy exit logic has real-time dependencies (price, volume, time-based triggers)

description: Telegram sends notification when logger records critical event; verify logger-triggered notifications are not duplicated with explicit send calls
expectedBehavior: Critical log events trigger exactly one notification via Telegram
failureMode: Double-notification: logger sends to Telegram, and calling code also sends directly
prerequisites: Critical event is logged by logger AND calling code also sends Telegram notification

description: Dashboard API routes handle errors; verify Express error middleware catches all route errors
expectedBehavior: Errors in route handlers are caught by Express error middleware and returned as 500
failureMode: Unhandled promise rejections in async routes crash the dashboard process
prerequisites: API route throws an asynchronous error without catch handler

description: Pro-orchestrator simulation component uses backtest engine; verify simulation parameters map correctly
expectedBehavior: Pro-orchestrator passes decision parameters to backtest for forward simulation
failureMode: Simulation uses different market data window than live evaluation, producing misleading simulation results
prerequisites: Pro-orchestrator is configured to run simulations before decisions

description: Kill switch triggers automation control to stop; verify kill-switch properly communicates with automation system
expectedBehavior: Kill switch activates automation control stop mechanism
failureMode: Automation control ignores kill-switch signal if running in a separate process
prerequisites: Kill-switch condition is met

description: Readiness check probes all subsystems; verify readiness correctly reports degraded state when any module fails
expectedBehavior: Readiness returns aggregate status of all probed subsystems
failureMode: Readiness probe for one module throws exception, preventing other probes from running
prerequisites: One module is in degraded state while others are healthy

description: Executor wallet operations require discovery data; verify wallet discovery feeds into execution planning
expectedBehavior: Wallet discovery identifies available tokens and executor uses this for sell decisions
failureMode: Stale wallet discovery data causes executor to attempt selling tokens no longer held
prerequisites: Wallet discovery runs on schedule, executor triggers sell between discovery runs

description: State pruner removes old entries; verify pruner correctly identifies and removes stale state without locking issues
expectedBehavior: Pruner iterates state entries, removes stale ones, writes clean state
failureMode: State pruner holds write lock too long, blocking all concurrent state access
prerequisites: State file is large with many entries to prune

description: Trade attribution records feed into metrics; verify attribution data correctly updates win/loss metrics
expectedBehavior: Trade attribution results are consumed by metrics for performance tracking
failureMode: Metrics double-counts trades that are attributed multiple times through different paths
prerequisites: Trade completes with attribution data available

description: Trading plan dictates which strategies pro-orchestrator evaluates; verify plan constraints are respected
expectedBehavior: Pro-orchestrator consults trading plan before evaluating opportunities
failureMode: Trading plan limits (max positions, tokens per day) are not checked before evaluation, wasting resources
prerequisites: Trading plan has active constraints on strategy execution

description: Strategy evolution engine mutates strategy parameters; verify mutated strategies are correctly instantiated
expectedBehavior: Evolved strategies are created from mutation of parent strategy parameters
failureMode: Parameter mutation produces invalid strategy configuration that crashes on instantiation
prerequisites: Strategy evolution cycle triggers mutation of active strategy

description: Strategy gate validates strategies before registration; verify gate criteria match registry expectations
expectedBehavior: Gate validates strategy meets minimum criteria before allowing registry registration
failureMode: Gate uses different validation criteria than registry, allowing strategies that fail at runtime
prerequisites: Strategy is submitted for registration through the gate

description: Runtime selector picks optimal strategy; verify selector correctly reads strategy metadata from registry
expectedBehavior: Runtime selector queries strategy registry for available strategies and selects best fit
failureMode: Metadata mismatch between selector query and registry schema causes strategy selection failure
prerequisites: Multiple strategies are registered and runtime selector must choose one

description: Gemini bridge receives market analysis and feeds into narrative detection; verify LLM output correctly parsed
expectedBehavior: Gemini analysis results are parsed and narrative detection updates its state
failureMode: LLM output format changes cause parsing failure, silently dropping narrative updates
prerequisites: Gemini bridge is active and receiving market analysis requests

description: Local Claude proxy provides LLM signals to pro-orchestrator; verify proxy response format is compatible
expectedBehavior: Proxy returns formatted analysis that pro-orchestrator incorporates into decision signals
failureMode: Proxy timeout or error is not handled gracefully, causing pro-orchestrator stall
prerequisites: Local Claude proxy is configured as LLM provider

description: LLM provider abstraction routes to different backends; verify strategy evolution uses correct provider
expectedBehavior: Strategy evolution uses configured LLM provider for strategy generation
failureMode: Provider routing mismatch causes evolution to use wrong model or fail
prerequisites: Multiple LLM providers are configured with fallback routing

description: Dashboard config-writer modifies user-config.json; verify changes are picked up by config reload
expectedBehavior: Config-writer writes changes to user-config.json and triggers reload signal
failureMode: Config file write conflicts with hot-reload read, causing partial config load
prerequisites: Operator modifies config via dashboard while config hot-reload timer fires

description: Dashboard state-reader polls state for broadcast; verify read consistency with concurrent writes
expectedBehavior: State-reader reads state file and returns consistent snapshot
failureMode: State-reader reads state mid-write, getting partial data that corrupts dashboard display
prerequisites: State is being written by another module while state-reader polls

description: Decision workflow orchestrates multi-step decisions; verify workflow stages are correctly sequenced

description: Memory pressure: OOM conditions cause intermittent failures

description: Token passes all 5 filter stages by narrow margins (borderline token)

description: WebSocket connection receives partial or fragmented messages

description: Helius API returns 429 during WebSocket reconnection (backoff reset)

description: Vault sweep destination address is the same as source (self-transfer)

description: System clock jumps forward or backward (NTP sync, daylight saving, VM pause/resume)

description: Dashboard has no CORS configuration (missing cors middleware)

description: No session management or token revocation endpoint exists (missing session lifecycle)

description: API routes have no request body size validation (missing payload size limit)

description: No audit log for config changes (missing config audit trail)

description: No cache for RugCheck results (missing response cache)

description: No data quality scoring for observations (missing quality filter)
